title: UPPER PUSH AND POSTURE
subtitle: TUESDAY KIND. SOFT PUSH. EASY POSTURE.

script.welcome: Hello Pam. I'm Stratton. Tuesday is upper push and posture — a short, kind break from the chair. About ten minutes. If a joint is sore, take a smaller range. Showing up is the win.
script.start: Whenever you're ready. Easy breath. This is meant to feel doable.
script.nextExercise: Next one. Shake it out if you like. No rush.
script.rest: Have a little rest. Breathe easy.
script.lastSet: Last set. Make it comfortable and clean.
script.complete: That's us. Lovely work. Soft push, easy posture, and you showed up. Enjoy your Tuesday — see you tomorrow.
script.resume: Back with you. Easy as we go.

exercises.name: WALL PUSH UPS
exercises.cue: Stand facing a clear wall, feet about hip-width a comfortable step back. Place palms on the wall at about shoulder height and a little wider than shoulders. Soft belly. Bend the elbows and bring the chest gently toward the wall, then press away with control. Soft neck. Smaller range is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Wall push ups to wake the chest and arms. Two sets of eight. Soft belly, palms on the wall, bend the elbows and bring the chest gently in, then press away. Soft neck. Smaller range is fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty five seconds. Soften the shoulders. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Wall push ups done. Nicely done.

exercises.name: SEATED OVERHEAD PRESS
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat. Soft belly. Hold light hand weights if you like, or empty hands. Start with hands near the shoulders, then press gently upward only as high as feels kind — a soft reach is plenty. Soft neck. Lower with control. Smaller range is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated overhead press for kind push and posture. Two sets of eight. Soft belly, hands near the shoulders, press gently up only as high as feels kind. Soft neck. Lower with control. Smaller range is fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Soften the shoulders. Easy breath.

exercises.name: SEATED ROW
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat. Soft belly. Elbows bent, hands forward as if holding light weights or a band. Draw the elbows back gently and squeeze the shoulder blades together a little, then ease forward with control. Soft neck. A smaller squeeze is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated row for easy posture. Two sets of eight. Soft belly, draw the elbows back and squeeze the shoulder blades a little, then ease forward. Soft neck. Smaller squeeze is fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Soften the upper back. Easy breath.

exercises.name: SEATED FORWARD REACH
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat. Soft belly. Hinge gently from the hips and reach the hands forward toward the floor or shins only as far as feels kind. Soft neck. Pause a soft breath at the end, then come back up with control. A smaller reach is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated forward reach to finish with a soft stretch. Two sets of five. Soft belly, hinge gently and reach forward only as far as feels kind. Soft neck. Pause a soft breath, then come up. Smaller reach is fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Soften the back. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Forward reach done. That's the session — lovely work.
